#!/bin/sh
# gamedash-managed Icarus server — generated by provision().
# Settings: <ROOT>/installs/icarus/gamedash-servers/test/Saved/Config/WindowsServer/ServerSettings.ini
. <ROOT>/secrets.conf
# keep the join + admin passwords in step with the ones set in GameDash
python3 - "<ROOT>/installs/icarus/gamedash-servers/test/Saved/Config/WindowsServer/ServerSettings.ini" "$GAME_SERVER_PASSWORD" "$GAME_ADMIN_PASSWORD" <<'SYNC'
import re, sys
p, join, admin = sys.argv[1:4]
t = open(p, encoding="utf-8").read()
for key, val in (("JoinPassword", join), ("AdminPassword", admin)):
    t = re.sub(r"(?m)^%s=.*$" % key, lambda m: key + "=" + val, t)
open(p, "w", encoding="utf-8").write(t)
SYNC
export WINEPREFIX="<ROOT>/home/.wine-gd-icarus-test"
export WINEDEBUG=-all
export WINEDLLOVERRIDES="mscoree,mshtml="   # no Mono/Gecko install prompts (headless)
# Run headless: Wine would otherwise open a console window on the desktop
# session (unsetting DISPLAY alone isn't enough — it falls back to Wayland).
unset DISPLAY
export WAYLAND_DISPLAY=wayland-none
cd "<ROOT>/installs/icarus/Icarus/Binaries/Win64" || exit 1
exec wine ./IcarusServer-Win64-Shipping.exe -Log -UserDir="Z:<WINROOT>\\installs\\icarus\\gamedash-servers\\test\\" \
    -SteamServerName="Test World" -PORT=17777 -QueryPort=27095
